rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Смотрите! Вот снежинка! У меня в лапке!
rows.text: Look! A snowflake! On my paw!
rows.heard: Look a snowflake on my paw.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Ого! Лучики! Раз, два, три, четыре, пять, шесть!
rows.text: Wow! Points! One, two, three, four, five, six!
rows.heard: Wow, points! One, two, three, four, five, six.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Она как звёздочка! Белая звёздочка!
rows.text: It's like a star! A little white star!
rows.heard: It's like a star, a little white star.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте посмотрим ещё одну. Вон их сколько летит!
rows.text: Let's look at another one. So many are falling!
rows.heard: Let's look at another one. So many are falling.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Поймал! И у этой шесть лучиков.
rows.text: Got one! This one has six points too.
rows.heard: Got one, this one has 6 points too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А мне снежинка села на нос! Сколько там лучиков?
rows.text: A snowflake landed on my nose! How many points?
rows.heard: A snowflake landed on my nose, how many points?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Рон, она уже растаяла. Нос у тебя тёплый!
rows.text: Ron, it already melted. Your nose is warm!
rows.heard: Ron, it already melted. Your nose is warm.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Почему у всех снежинок шесть лучиков? Вот это загадка!
rows.text: Why do all snowflakes have six points? What a mystery!
rows.heard: Why do all snowflakes have six points? What a mystery.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я найду самую большую снежинку!
rows.text: I'll find the biggest snowflake!
rows.heard: I'll find the biggest snowflake.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Большая улетела. А я приземлился.
rows.text: The big one flew away. And I landed.
rows.heard: The big one flew away, and I landed.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Они падают медленно. Как пушинки.
rows.text: They fall slowly. Like fluff.
rows.heard: They fall slowly like fluff.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Снежинка очень лёгкая, как пух. Её уносит ветер.
rows.text: A snowflake is light as fluff. The wind blows it away.
rows.heard: A snowflake is light as fluff, the wind blows it away.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А откуда они берутся?
rows.text: Where do they come from?
rows.heard: Where do they come from?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Из облака. Высоко-высоко над нами.
rows.text: From a cloud. High, high above us.
rows.heard: From a cloud, high, high above us.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Там, наверное, кто-то их вырезает. Ножницами.
rows.text: Someone up there must cut them out. With scissors.
rows.heard: Someone up there must cut them out with scissors.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Тогда ему работы на всю зиму!
rows.text: Then he's busy all winter!
rows.heard: Then he's busy all winter.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Пойдёмте пить чай. Пик расскажет, как рождается снежинка.
rows.text: Let's go have tea. Pik will tell us how a snowflake is born.
rows.heard: Let's go have tea. Pick will tell us how a snowflake is born.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, над чашкой пар. Это вода в воздухе.
rows.text: Look, steam over the cup. That's water in the air.
rows.heard: Look steam over the cup. That's water in the air.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: В облаке тоже вода. Много-много маленьких капелек.
rows.text: Clouds have water too. Lots of tiny drops.
rows.heard: Clowns have water too. Lots of tiny drops.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А наверху холодно?
rows.text: Is it cold up there?
rows.heard: Is it cold up there?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Очень холодно. Там капелька замерзает. Получается льдинка.
rows.text: Very cold. A drop freezes there. It turns into ice.
rows.heard: Very cold, a drop freezes there, it turns into ice.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Такая маленькая, что её не видно?
rows.text: So tiny you can't see it?
rows.heard: So tiny you can't see it.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. А потом к льдинке прилипают новые. И она становится больше.
rows.text: Yes. Then more stick to it. And it gets bigger.
rows.heard: Yes, then more stick to it, and it gets bigger.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Растёт ровно в шесть сторон. Так получаются лучики!
rows.text: It grows six ways, evenly. That makes the points!
rows.heard: It grows six ways evenly. That makes the points.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вода знает цифру шесть? Вот умница!
rows.text: Water knows the number six? How smart!
rows.heard: Water knows the number six, how smart.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Так устроен лёд. Шесть лучиков — всегда!
rows.text: That's how ice works. Always six points!
rows.heard: That's how ice works. Always 6 points.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А потом снежинка тяжелеет. И падает вниз.
rows.text: Then the snowflake gets heavy. And falls down.
rows.heard: then the snowflake gets heavy and falls down.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Проверим, где снежинка живёт дольше. Тарелка холодная, с мороза.
rows.text: Let's see where a snowflake lasts longer. This plate is cold from outside.
rows.heard: Let's see where a snowflake lasts longer. This plate is cold from outside.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А моя лапа тёплая. Ловлю!
rows.text: And my paw is warm. I'll catch one!
rows.heard: and my paw is warm, I'll catch one.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ой! Уже растаяла. Только капелька.
rows.text: Oh! It melted already. Just a little drop.
rows.heard: Oh, it melted already. Just a little drop.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Смотрите! На тарелку падают снежинки. И не тают!
rows.text: Look! Snowflakes are falling on the plate. And not melting!
rows.heard: Look, snowflakes are falling on the plate and not melting.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Тарелка холодная, как мороз. Снежинкам на ней не жарко.
rows.text: The plate is frosty cold. The snowflakes don't get hot.
rows.heard: The plate is frosty cold. The snowflakes don't get hot.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я тоже стану холодным. Как тарелка!
rows.text: Then I'll get cold too. Like the plate!
rows.heard: Then I'll get cold too, like the plate.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, ты тёплый. Под тобой снег растает!
rows.text: Ron, you're warm. The snow under you will melt!
rows.heard: Ron, you're warm. The snow under you will melt.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Правда? Тогда лужу не надо!
rows.text: Really? I don't want a puddle!
rows.heard: Really? I don't want to puddle.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Значит, снежинки любят холод. А в тепле становятся водой.
rows.text: So snowflakes love the cold. And in the warm, they turn into water.
rows.heard: So snowflakes love the cold, and in the warm, they turn into water.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я рисую снежинку. Сначала одна линия.
rows.text: I'm drawing a snowflake. First, one line.
rows.heard: I'm drawing a snowflake, first one line.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пока похоже на линию.
rows.text: Looks like a line.
rows.heard: Looks like a line.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Теперь ещё две, крест-накрест. Вот! Шесть лучиков!
rows.text: Now two more, crossing. There! Six points!
rows.heard: Now two more crossing. There are six points.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Как просто! Три линии — и шесть лучиков.
rows.text: So easy! Three lines, and six points.
rows.heard: So easy, three lines and six points.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А на концах можно веточки. Как ёлочки.
rows.text: You can add twigs at the ends. Like little fir trees.
rows.heard: you can add twigs at the ends, like little fir trees.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я нарисую снежинку с ушами. Как у меня.
rows.text: I'll draw a snowflake with ears. Like mine.
rows.heard: I'll draw snowflake with ears, like mine.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, у снежинок нет ушей!
rows.text: Ron, snowflakes don't have ears!
rows.heard: Ron, snowflakes don't have ears.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Она особенная. Она слушает зиму.
rows.text: It's special. It listens to winter.
rows.heard: It's special, it listens to winter.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте ловить снежинки на шарф. На тёмном их лучше видно.
rows.text: Let's catch snowflakes on a scarf. They're easier to see on dark.
rows.heard: Let's catch snowflakes on a scarf. They're easier to see on dark.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: У меня шарф зелёный. Ловите!
rows.text: My scarf is green. Catch!
rows.heard: My scarf is green. Catch.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Эта с веточками. А эта как цветочек.
rows.text: This one has twigs. This one's like a flower.
rows.heard: This one has twigs, this one's like a flower.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А эта похожа на звёздочку.
rows.text: And this one's like a star.
rows.heard: And this one's like a star.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Двух одинаковых снежинок не бывает. Все разные.
rows.text: No two snowflakes are the same. They're all different.
rows.heard: No two snowflakes are the same. They're all different.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Прямо как мы!
rows.text: Just like us!
rows.heard: Just like us.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, ты точно один такой!
rows.text: Ron, there's only one of you!
rows.heard: Ron, there's only one of you.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот моя снежинка. Пусть будет у меня. На память.
rows.text: Here's my snowflake. I'll keep it. As a keepsake.
rows.heard: Here's my snowflake, I'll keep it, as a keepsake.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рон, она же растает…
rows.text: Ron, it'll melt.
rows.heard: Run, it'll melt.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тихо! Это тайна.
rows.text: Shh! It's a secret.
rows.heard: As I change, it's a secret.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотрите, что у меня в кармане!
rows.text: Look what's in my pocket!
rows.heard: Look what's in my pocket.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Пропала! Тут только мокро!
rows.text: Oh! It's gone! It's just wet!
rows.heard: Oh, it's gone. It's just wet.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: В тепле снежинка тает. И становится капелькой воды.
rows.text: In the warm, a snowflake melts. And turns into a drop of water.
rows.heard: In the warm, a snowflake melts and turns into a drop of water.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Снежинка — это лёд. Красивый, но очень маленький.
rows.text: A snowflake is ice. Pretty, but very tiny.
rows.heard: A snowflake is ice, pretty but very tiny.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Растаяла. Жалко.
rows.text: It melted. Too bad.
rows.heard: It melted too bad.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Не грусти, Рон. На улице их целый миллион!
rows.text: Don't be sad, Ron. There's a whole million outside!
rows.heard: Don't be sad, Ron. There's a whole million outside.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Даже больше миллиона!
rows.text: Even more than a million!
rows.heard: even more than a million.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда пусть живут на улице. Там им холодно.
rows.text: Then they can live outside. It's nice and cold there.
rows.heard: Then they can live outside. It's nice and cold there.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем! Все кружатся, как снежинки.
rows.text: Let's play! Everyone spin like snowflakes.
rows.heard: Let's play Everyone Spin Like Snowflakes.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я снежинка, которая упала первой.
rows.text: I'm the snowflake that fell first!
rows.heard: I'm the snowflake that fell first.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: У снежинки шесть лучиков. Двух одинаковых не бывает. В тепле она тает.
rows.text: Snowflakes have six points. No two are alike. And warmth melts them.
rows.heard: Snowflakes have six points, no two are alike, and warmth melts them.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Завтра снега будет ещё больше.
rows.text: Tomorrow there'll be even more snow.
rows.heard: Tomorrow there will be even more snow.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, пойдём на горку!
rows.text: Then we'll go to the hill!
rows.heard: Then we'll go to the hill.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Горка! Ура!
rows.text: The hill! Yay!
rows.heard: At the hill, yay!

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: С горки едешь сам. А в гору надо тащить. Почему так?
rows.text: Down the hill, the sled goes by itself. Up the hill, you pull it. Why?
rows.heard: Down the hill the sled goes by itself. Up the hill you pull it, why?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот это загадка! Завтра проверим на горке!
rows.text: What a mystery! Tomorrow we'll check on the hill!
rows.heard: What a mystery. Tomorrow we'll check on the hill.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу поставить лайк и подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
